tables.name: Deliveries
tables.grain: one row per delivery; fuel_cost at delivery grain

tables.name: Exceptions
tables.grain: one row per exception; delivery_id foreign key; many per delivery possible

measures.name: fuel_cost
measures.basis: The approved rule retains one lowest-exception_id row per qualifying delivery_id, so each matching delivery is represented once before grouping; fuel_cost is additive at delivery grain.

sequence: Join Deliveries to Exceptions on delivery_id.
Deduplicate filtered rows by delivery_id, retaining the lowest exception_id.
risks: Safety depends on applying the approved deduplication rule exactly within this summary.
Structural safety does not verify observed numerical accuracy.
